guards.name: the file list is not empty
guards.what: A broken glob would make the parse test below pass over nothing.

guards.name: every source file parses
guards.what: Zero tolerance. A file that cannot be compiled is never acceptable.

guards.name: a module docstring is closed by the line that opens it
guards.what: The specific corruption that took ten files out.

guards.name: no new undefined names
guards.what: Shrink-only, like ``provenance_backlog.txt``.

guards.name: the backlog only shrinks
guards.what: A backlog entry that no longer occurs must be deleted, not left to rot.

guards.name: the mangled detector finds code and ignores prose
guards.what: Two bugs this guard was written after, pinned as tests.

guards.name: the mangled detector finds mid word damage
guards.what: The casualties the head-only pattern never saw, and the words it must not flag.

guards.name: the mangled detector finds fused remnants
guards.what: Where the capital went with "Coll", the remnant fused onto the word before it.

guards.name: the mangled detector reads typescript names not its strings
no new mangled identifiers
guards.what: Gated at zero since 25 Sept 2026, when the last casualty was restored.

guards.name: the mangled backlog only shrinks
guards.what: An entry that no longer occurs must be deleted, not left to rot.

guards.name: the dangling import scan is not vacuous
guards.what: A broken root map would make this pass over nothing.

guards.name: no new dangling first party imports
guards.what: Shrink-only, like the backlogs above.

guards.name: the dangling backlog only shrinks
the enum scan catches a missing member
guards.what: Not vacuous: the same shape as the two defects that prompted this.

guards.name: no enum member is referenced without being defined
no unresolved patch targets
guards.what: No test patches a name its target module does not have.

guards.name: the patch backlog stays empty
guards.what: The backlog file is kept, empty, as the place a deliberate exception would go.

guards.name: the stub scan finds the known ones
guards.what: Not vacuous: the backlog is non-empty and the scan should rediscover it.

guards.name: no new stubs shadow an installed module
guards.what: Shrink-only, like the backlogs above.

guards.name: the module stub backlog only shrinks
no new third party ai call escapes a control
guards.what: Shrink-only, like the backlogs above.

guards.name: the ai egress backlog only shrinks
no settings attribute is spelled as its env alias
guards.what: `settings.MIN_EVENTS` is not `settings.min_events`, and it raises.

guards.name: no new call site passes a keyword its callee rejects
guards.what: A wrong keyword is a ``TypeError`` the moment that line runs.

guards.name: no guarded code reads an attribute its class never assigns
guards.what: An attribute nothing assigns is an ``AttributeError`` every time the line runs.

guards.name: no new blocking call runs on the event loop
guards.what: A synchronous database or network call in an ``async def`` holds every other request.

guards.name: no new broad handler turns a capability failure into a default
guards.what: ``except Exception`` is how three of this codebase's worst defects stayed hidden.

guards.name: no new value is served to the user without a source
guards.what: A fabricated value is worse than a missing one: it looks exactly like a real one.

guards.name: no two test files have identical content
guards.what: A duplicated test file runs everything in it twice and proves nothing extra.

guards.name: no client call names a route the api does not serve
guards.what: Every ``apiClient`` call must resolve to a path and verb the application serves.

guards.name: no route is mounted at only one prefix
guards.what: Every route served at `/api` must also be served at `/api/v1`, and back.

guards.name: no route escapes the api prefix
guards.what: A route served only at the root is unreachable through either API gate.

guards.name: prefix twins enforce the same authentication
guards.what: A route served under both prefixes must require the same thing under each.

guards.name: the openapi snapshot matches the application
guards.what: The committed snapshot is what the web client's generated types come from.

guards.name: the event spine only grows
guards.what: Every input should publish to the event spine, and every reaction should be reachable.

guards.name: no async session parameter is given the sync session
